nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Chuyện vặt hằng ngày · bài tự soạn
title: Group chat · Floor 3 neighbors
L: Dina: Hi everyone! Just a reminder that the trash truck is coming on Thursday this week, not Wednesday.
Ben: Thanks for the heads-up! I was about to put my bags out tonight.
Mr. Cruz: I'll be away from Friday to Monday. Could someone water my plants?
Dina: No problem, I live right next door. Just give me the key before you leave.
Mr. Cruz: That's very kind of you. I'll bring you a small gift from my trip.
Ben: Also, whoever left the bike in the hallway, please move it. People keep tripping over it!
Dina: Oops, that's mine! Sorry, I'll take it to the basement right now.

exq.q: Chỗ trống 1: Just a reminder that the trash truck is coming ___ Thursday this week, not Wednesday.
exq.why: on + thứ trong tuần: on Thursday.

exq.q: Chỗ trống 2: Thanks for the heads-___! I was about to put my bags out tonight.
exq.why: heads-up = lời báo trước; Ben định đem rác ra tối nay nên được nhắc kịp.

exq.q: Chỗ trống 3: Could someone ___ my plants?
exq.why: water my plants = tưới cây giúp tôi; ông Cruz đi vắng từ thứ Sáu tới thứ Hai.

exq.q: Chỗ trống 4: That's very kind ___ you.
exq.why: It’s kind of you = bạn tốt bụng quá.

exq.q: Whose bike was in the hallway?
